You thought we were DONE, Orpheans?
Well, guess again. Weapon rebalancing, buffs and gun tweaks, THIS 1.0.1.4 patch hits harder than a Multicannon.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/e5b678f6e204d05bcdebca11f39f7156198ed46f.png"]
Overall Shotgun spread has decreased.
All early weapons have been buffed.
Specific late-game weapons have been buffed.
Type-9 - Spread reduced by 30%. Increased reload speed by 20%.
FL9-Mod - Increased reload speed by 20%.
Master Enforcer - Fire rate increased from 2 to 2.5.
Golden Sunset - Fire rate increased from 1.25 to 1.5.
GX7 Short Barrel Blaster - Damage increased from 6 to 7.
MKII - Damage increased from 10 to 12.
ION-DS - Spread reduced by 15%.
TVA-5 - Spread reduced by 40%. Bullet physical cost reduced from 24 to 12.
Nano Ravid - Reduced ammo cost from 4 energy to 3 energy.
R55 Long Scope - Increased reload speed by 20%.
Rising Horizon - Increased base damage from 20 to 25.
Psioglove - Reduce charge time from 3 sec to 2 sec.
AAT Multicannon - Initial accuracy increased by 50%.
Impact Hammer - Base damage increased from 8 to 15 (Nail damage remains the same).
DB5 Break Action - Spread reduced by 40%. Bullet physical cost reduced from 25 to 15.

releases.displayName: Black Mesa x Moros Protocol Bundle And Update

items.text: Darkphage activity aboard the vessel has increased exponentially, and standard containment measures are proving… insufficient. Effective immediately, the following has been authorized for deployment: THE CROWBAR.

Originally recovered during an unplanned containment breach at the Black Mesa Research Facility, this device has demonstrated remarkable utility in neutralising small structural hazards, forced entry scenarios and, incidentally, hostile organisms. Remember: the crowbar is your friend… unless it’s not. Then it’s still a crowbar.
Your mission: survive the infestation, secure the ship and try not to break anything critical…

To celebrate the launch of this new tool, we are offering our lowest base game discount yet at 30% off, as part of Steam’s Winter Sale. We have also coordinated with the Black Mesa research facility staff to offer a bundle with an extra 10% off both games. This bundle will run for a limited time, so do purchase while you can. Play responsibly.
We’re also receiving reports of 3 new life forms aboard the Orpheus…
In Area 1, the Arachne. This zombie-like spider creature would give a headcrab a run for its money. Proceed with caution.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/0fc9add65f731cd5bb5b11a7f9f203d517ed1352.jpg"]
In Area 2, come face-to-face with the Decaying Nychosaur. In the words of the Black Mesa facility’s Security Bulletin #04-1997, investigate responsibly. Or destroy them. Your call.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/ad8f8a13f2f77462db5b49b2ffb6dae3a5157ea9.jpg"]

And finally, in Area 3, the Sister of Carnage. This is one sibling you do not wish to pick a fight with. Remember: the Orpheus protects you from everything… except your own mistakes. Each miniboss requires a unique door unlocking method to access the room, so proceed slowly…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/a43f7f449bb4daee599f4607fad579f7122dad1c.jpg"]
New Weapons
Plasma Arbalest.
FL9-Mod.
Heavy Siege Axe.
The Rising Blade (Undocumented gimmick: Forward dashing on heavy attack and increased range).
The Black Mesa Facility Crowbar (Undocumented gimmick: No damage from secret room doors).
Augments
You can now sell your augments on the Remix vendor.
New mystery augment (Requirement to open miniboss entrance).
Weapon Balance Changes
Bonespitter Weapon damage buff.
Psionic blaster Weapon fire rate and damage buff.
Nano Ravid Weapon bullet cost reduced.
Area Balance Changes
Secret Rooms rewards rebalanced.
UI Balance Changes
Stat upgrade rewards (e.g., challenge rewards) now have a tooltip to inform about their upgrade.
Weapon Bug Fixes & Improvements
Charging type ranged weapons now account for the fire rate properly.
Gunslinger Run-modifier - Allow melee weapon pickup.
Stop weapon loop sounds when entering cutscenes.
Augment Bug Fixes & Improvements
Fixed splitting bullets augment applying more than once on specific weapons.
Field medic augment - fixed UI not updating.
Placebo effect augment - fixed UI not updating.
Fixed augments getting stuck in an unusable state when trying to move them.
Fixed a bug where un-equipping an augment could bring your HP and max HP below 1.
Area Bug Fixes & Improvements
Area 3 pathway collision fixes.
Fixed an issue where part of the wall was missing at the corner of the room if a pathway was spawned there.
Fixed some instances that led to the player falling off the map.
Fixed a room that would spawn enemies outside, creating a softlock.
Fixed a bug that stopped map generation bricking the run.
Co-Op Bug Fixes & Improvements
Fixed a bug where a player could get past a door while the other player was in the previous room (making them drop momentarily).
Cutscene Bug Fixes & Improvements
Blob Boss cutscene bug fix.
Cutscene's camera rotation fixes (all cutscenes).
Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash during dialogues/cutscenes when running on Windows with a Turkish locale.
Other Bug Fixes & Improvements
Fixed the enemy Marauder's charge attack pushing the player out of the map.
Upgrades to menu controller support.
Fixed the map moving around with the mouse without clicking inside it.
Fixed a minor memory leak from the weapon UI.
Fixed multiple points of the game crashing during or after bosses.
Enemies that are considered "stuck" will now teleport away from the player when possible.
WARNING - Please start a fresh run after updating

There's a known issue where continuing a run causes equipped augments to disappear/change, and slots to glitch out. To avoid this, please start a fresh run. Alternatively, you can choose to use the “Revert” branch in Steam betas to continue and finish your current run. You will need to switch back to the default build after this run is completed.
“Free resources are still resources.” Black Mesa Logistics Memo.

Command will also authorize a live briefing and observational broadcast of Update 1.0.12. This session will include a real-time Q&A with Nick from Pixel Reign, during which new systems, tools, and containment measures will be demonstrated live. Keep an eye on our Discord for more information.
“Please remain calm. Questions are permitted. Panic is not.” Black Mesa Public Outreach Division.
We recommend that all personnel attend. Absence will not be recorded, but you may regret missing it.
See you in the stars 🌠
— Pixel Reign 🚀

notes.title: Transmission: Moros Protocol Post-Launch Patch 1.0.10 Deployed

items.text: Errors and anomalies aboard the Orpheus have been identified by the maintenance crew. Work has been completed and all crew members will now notice synchronisation with protocol parameters are improved.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/973229ff9fecbd220a6ce01456618f9cb8ddc1f0.png"]
Weapons

Psiogloves: Damage increased by 5 (10 damage per shot -> 15 damage per shot). Augment slots increased by 1 (2 slots -> 3 slots). Visual bug fixed (some players managed to get the sphere fx stuck on their weapon).
Metal Storm: Augment slots increased by 1 (2 slots -> 3 slots). Tier increased ( tier 2 -> tier 3).
DualStr8Fires: Ammo consumption increased (1 per shot -> 1.5 per shot).
XM LED Strobe: Ammo consumption increased (1 per bullet to 2 per bullet).
Nano Ravid: Clip size increased to 25 (previously 20).
Weapon descriptions: Fire rate now shows proper rarity scaling when on the ground. Damage now includes players bioboost upgrades when on the ground (for proper comparison).
Weapon levels: Damage increase reduced from 10% to 5%.

Weapon upgrades: Vendor prices greatly reduced. (this will make the players be able to buff their weapons more, making the high damage of any weapon be the result of player weapon rather than finding a high level weapon from the chest).
Stamina: Base stamina of the player increased (30 stamina -> 40 stamina).
Jumping: Players can now jump during both the reloading and the healing animations.
Challenge Rooms: More rewards are accessible to the player after they complete it. The rewards scale accordingly to the difficulty level of the challenge room.
Vendor NPC: Fixed a bug that swapped the fire rate of your ranged weapons.
Co-op: Now you can see your team mate on the big map. Obstacles now trigger correctly when entered/exited.
Lepper: New enemy added.
OOC Marauder: HP increased (120 to 150).
Fixed an issue with staggered enemies.
Fixed bugs on the laser attack of Sentinels of Ceroboros boss.
Graphics: Camera shake max limit was fixed.
Upgraded Unity Version to patch Unity’s recent security vulnerability.
Barracks Area: Optimizations on obstacles. Fixes on maps.
OOC Frigate Area: Fixes on maps.
Challenge Rooms: Fixes applied.
Reduced performance cost of hallways and teleporters.
Optimised lighting shaders.
Moved music track loading to background execution and preload them during loading to optimise performance dips when loading a new room.
Cleanup residual temp objects after Room generation.
Defer unloading of rooms to later frames to reduce performance dips during room culling.
Co-Op: Move dead player’s body to a reachable location when the terrain changes during bosses. Fixed an issue with some cutscenes locking a player out of the room when the other player triggered it.

Flight crew hopes that these improvements are satisfactory and contribute to your continued support of the project. Don’t hesitate to leave field reports as your feedback is invaluable to the future aboard the Orpheus.
Make sure to join us on the official Moros Protocol Discord for real-time updates and direct anomaly reports, too.
See you in the stars 🌠
